facts.fact: The Minister of Social Development says SASSA requires an electronic Know Your Client (eKYC) process with compulsory biometric verification for flagged SRD grant records, and biometric verification has been mandatory for all new SRD applications since 6 June 2025.

The Minister of Social Development says SRD grant payments run through beneficiary bank accounts, with accounts lacking biometric FICA verification placed in a 'referred' status that blocks further payments.
facts.system: SASSA Social Relief of Distress grant

ZAF.note: The document concerns biometric checks on SRD grant applicants, not the national ID system's enrolment, uniqueness or certification.
The document describes biometric verification of SRD applicants but does not say they are checked against the national ID.
